title: First recording sessions: Brunis, Shockey, Almerico
summary: His first recording was with Abby Brunis; later he recorded with Shockey and Almerico.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now

blocks.x: Yeah. Did you record with him? No. No, I never made no records. When was your first recording session, by the way?
My first recording session was with Abby Bruner, that I can remember. Yeah.
And did you make any more records until the 1940s?

Yeah, after I left Bruner. Uh huh. Yeah, I made some records with Shockey. I think I made some with Shockey. I made some with Al Marika. That's about all. Remember any of the tunes you made with Shockey? Huh? Remember any tunes you made with Shockey? No, I don't remember any of them.
Was that in late years or was that during the 30s or what? That was in later years. That's my daughter. Yeah.
